text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: org="velvetpay" - sudden QPS spike + 502s at edge. Error rate ↑ 11.8% over 3m. Paging on-call: @sre_elias. Incident ID INC-4625

sre_elias: On-call, looking. Can someone grab quick org traffic breakdown? I see a concentrated client api_key from EU region.

ops_maya: grabbing logs & trace. Repro: POST /v1/generate with large batch payloads. QPS ~15x usual, queue depth spiking on worker-pool-7.

sre_elias: Cause looks like per-org queue buildup hitting soft RL + autoscale lag. Plan: temporary emergency RL increase for velvetpay + disable experimental batch streaming for that org. 15m window, monitor.

ops_maya: Executing change now:
```
# bump soft qps for org velvetpay for 15m
rbac adjust-rate --org velvetpay --soft-qps 600 --duration 15m --reason "emergent spike"
```

deploybot: Action recorded: rbac adjust-rate by ops_maya at 4625012400. New soft-qps=600, ttl=15m.

sre_elias: Also toggling feature flag to disable batch-stream for their app path.

ops_maya: Disabled batch-stream flag for velvetpay: `ff toggle -o velvetpay batch-stream off`

eng_runtime_joe: Recommend also setting fallback model routing to a lighter quantized variant for velvetpay until stable.

platform_robin: Done. Route override pushed: velvetpay -> model-xq8-fallback (read-only) for 20m.

incidents-bot: METRICS: errors 11.8% -> 0.5% (5m after changes). p95 latency 1.9s -> 410ms. Queue depth worker-pool-7 normalized.

pm_dan: Customer impact: degraded generation for some requests, but no customer outage. Notifying account team.

sre_elias: Good. Keep watch for 15m TTL. If sustained, we'll add short-term reserved capacity or negotiate burst package.

ops_maya: Adding temporary org quota note: velvetpay_burst_applied=true in incident log.

sre_elias: Handoff to @oncall_next_kim in 30m. Summary: velvetpay spike due to malformed high-volume batch traffic. Applied soft-qps=600 for 15m, disabled batch-stream, routed to fallback model. Errors & latency recovered. Next actions: monitor for recurrence, consider per-client rate-limiting rules.

oncall_next_kim: Ack, I'll take 00:30 UTC handoff and keep an eye on the dashboards. If errors creep back, re-run the bump and open follow-up ticket INC-4625-FOLLOWUP.

sre_elias: Closing this thread for active mitigation; leaving incident open for follow-up.
